name: Electricity demand and industrial output
fields: industry including construction, value added (constant 2015 US$)
join: Exact economy code and calendar year within the shared time span. National and territorial rows only. Missing cells stay blank. Economy names use the World Bank label where available. Kosovo uses the source code XKX, mapped to the KOS outline.
growth: For each measure, 100 × (end / start − 1). Both measures must be present at each selected endpoint, each start value must be positive and the end year must follow the start year. The mapped gap is demand growth minus industrial value-added growth, in percentage points.
indices: Each measure is 100 in the chosen start year. Each later point requires both source values in that year. Exact source levels remain available even when only one is published.
interpretation: Demand covers domestic generation plus net imports, including losses, across the entire economy. Industrial value added measures production less intermediate inputs in mining, manufacturing, utilities and construction. Changes describe co-movement. Ember can use economic assumptions when estimating recent electricity observations.
